relationships.description: The span link points to the linked span, typically a producer or upstream operation, through its SpanContext so that the span carrying the link records a causal but non-parent-child connection to that operation, such as a batch consumer span pointing to each message's producer span.
relationships.evidence: Instrumentation code passes a Link built from the producer span's extracted SpanContext (e.g. from message headers) in the links option of tracer.startSpan for the consumer span, and exported trace data shows the link's traceId/spanId matching spans emitted at the producer's code location.

notes: Because the span model element is a code-location definition and not a runtime occurrence, the link really references the span definition whose runtime instances it points to. The span-link-to-carrier ownership (composed-of from span) is not covered here and may need a separate relationship.
